messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-runtime p95 latency exceeded 320ms in us-west for the past 3m. Pager routed to #eng-oncall.

Maya: I'm jumping on this as primary. seeing a sustained p95 spike around 21:00 UTC. will share quick findings in this thread. taking over primary for ~45m while Dev goes finish a PR. :handshake:

Devon: noted — I'm still on a short deploy but can be secondary after ~20m. quick telemetry: CPU on gpu-pool-3 jumped +40%, KV cache evictions spiked. not seeing increased error rates yet. link to graphs: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inf-latency

Alex SRE: likely culprit is cache churn from an upstream job that started at ~20:58 UTC. runbook pointer: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-latency.md -> section "eviction storms". Recommend temporary alert dial-down on the kv-evict noisy alert and enable graceful fallback routing to smaller model variant. Also consider increasing p95 threshold for customer-facing alert so it doesn't page again while we mitigate.

Maya: ok doing two actions now:
1) suppress noisy kv-evict alert for 30m (will annotate)
2) set routing fallback -> model-alpha-small (same quality, lower throughput) for requests hitting pool-3

Command I'm running to suppress alert (monitoring-api):

```
curl -X POST "https://monitoring-api.internal/alerts/suppress" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MONITOR_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"alert":"kv-evict-spike","duration_minutes":30,"reason":"eviction storm during oncall shift, mitigations in progress - Maya"}'
```

Maya: also kicking a canary fallback config via the router:

```
# router patch
PATCH /v1/routing/pool-3
{ "fallback_model": "model-alpha-small", "rollout": "immediate", "annotation": "temp-fallback-eviction-21:05UTC" }
```

DeployBot: Canary rollback: model-alpha-large -> model-alpha-small rollback executed at 21:07 UTC in pool-3 by Maya (auto). No errors reported.

Rita: quick customer check — which tenants are hitting pool-3? I pulled top 5 tenants, looks like mostly non-enterprise dev orgs and some scheduled batch jobs. enterprise-prod tenants are on pool-7, not impacted. uplift: +0.3% error rate for a small dev tenant.

Devon: good. given limited customer impact, let's avoid broad SLO change but we should temporarily change the pager routing for the p95 alert so it doesn't escalate to oncall rotation while we observe. Proposal: change paging to only_notify oncall for 30m, keep analytics alerting. Who can edit paging rules?

Alex SRE: I can patch the rota rule. will change pages -> notify-only for the p95-critical rule and add annotation to revert at 21:45 UTC. Snippet of the alert config I'm updating:

```
alert: inference_p95_critical
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.32
for: 5m
actions:
  - pager: eng-oncall
  - notify: slack-channel:eng-oncall (notify-only)
```

Alex SRE: patch applied at 21:10 UTC. pager -> notify-only for 35m, annotation: "temp notify-only - eviction mitigation in progress".

Maya: confirmed router fallback applied and suppression active. KV evictions trending down after upstream job slowdown. p95 dropped from 420ms -> 260ms over the last 4m. current p95 ~ 260ms.

Rita: I'll update the internal customer-impact doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/notes/2208473620 (short note: limited dev-tenant impact, enterprise unaffected). Adding checklist to follow up with infra team tomorrow to avoid batch job hitting pool-3.

Devon: thanks. one more operational ask: if latency remains elevated, after 30m we should escalate to pool autoscale (add one GPU) instead of broad SLO changes. Keep the routing fallback as a persistent mitigation.

Maya: agreed. I scheduled an autoscale job if p95 > 350ms for 10m. rule id: autoscale-policy-3. I'll keep an eye for the next 20m and then hand primary to Devon. leaving a note for handover:
- Primary: Maya until 21:30 UTC
- Secondary: Devon starting 21:30 UTC
- Suppressions: kv-evict suppressed until 21:37 UTC
- Pager: notify-only until 21:45 UTC
- Router fallback: model-alpha-small active on pool-3 until manually reverted

Devon: I'll take primary at 21:30 UTC. If autoscale triggers, I'll verify the new nodes join and monitor gpustat. If we see regression, I'll rollback the fallback and re-enable pager escalation.

Alex SRE: Please remember to add post-incident runbook notes: steps taken, commands used, timestamps for suppress/revert. I'll create a follow-up ticket to review scheduled jobs that can cause eviction storms.

Maya: adding final confirm: I will revert suppressions and pager policy if p95 stays < 300ms for 10m, or at 21:45 UTC at latest. Leaving this thread open for handoff. :white_check_mark:

Rita: thanks all — documenting and will ping customer success if anything changes. :memo:

Maya: handing primary to Devon now. Devon, you're primary as of 21:30 UTC. tagging you: @Devon

Devon: thanks — I'm primary. monitoring now. :eyes:

OpsBot: Incident note: mitigation actions taken: suppress-kv-evict (21:06 UTC), router-fallback (21:07 UTC), pager-notify-only (21:10 UTC), autoscale-policy armed. Incident status: monitoring.
